title: docs(changeset): point the gantt parity clause at the instrument that can answer it
body:
Fixes #9743

Clause-②: no

Two pending release declarations justify a decision with a guarantee the instrument they name could not give. ⭐ **The conclusion is true and does not move** — no `KnownDrift` entry is added, no declaration face and no mirror is touched. Only the **justification** is replaced, so this is deliberately ⛔ not written up as "a false sentence was corrected".

## The finding

Both bodies explained the decision by crediting the `zod-mirror-parity` ratchet with a zero-drift reading for the gantt pair. objectui#9711 (landed by PR objectui#9725) established that the ratchet was structurally blind to the MIRRORED-but-undeclared direction ⇒ a zero from it recorded that it had not looked in that direction, not that nothing was there.

## The repair, per file

The instrument now exists, so each paragraph points at one that really does answer the question. `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` registers `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGanttSchema` in both its mirror map and its declaration map; `assertionMirroredUndeclaredMatchesLedger` reconciles every registered pair's mirrored-but-undeclared key set against that pair's `MirroredUndeclared` ledger entry — `never` for a pair the ledger does not name — and `assertionNoVacuousMirroredUndeclaredMeasurement` refuses a measurement that has degenerated to `any`.

Per commandment #9, each repaired paragraph **points at that reconciliation and dates its own reading** rather than writing the answer down: these bodies publish verbatim at an unknown future date, so an undated present-tense figure would read as live forever.

| `.changeset/6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md` | prose only, frontmatter byte-identical |
| `.changeset/9743-gantt-ratchet-rationale-retired.md` | new, EMPTY frontmatter |

⛔ Nothing else. No declaration face, no mirror, no test, no script.

## Measurement 1 — the ledger, re-measured here, ⛔ not inherited

Read off the brace-matched `MirroredUndeclared` block in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` at `1cfdff814`, on a block delimited by brace balance rather than a fixed line window (a fixed window is what saw only part of it on the filing seat's first pass).

| probe over the brace-matched block, 8 entries | result |
|---|---|
| `gantt`, case-insensitive | **0** |
| [LIT CTRL] `DashboardConfigSchema` | 1 |
| [LIT CTRL] `ObjectGridSchema` | 2 |
| [LIT CTRL] `operators` | 4 |
| [ABSENT CTRL] a minted pair name | 0 |

⭐ **And the zero is a measurement rather than an absence of looking**, which is the whole point of this card: the gantt pair is ENROLLED in the instrument — `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGanttSchema` appears in the `MIRRORS` map and in the `Declared` map, so `MirrorKey` covers it and the reconciliation above resolves it to `never`.

## Measurement 2 — assertion position vs quoted position

⭐ A count is invariant under quotation, so the two positions are probed separately. Corpus: every pending `.changeset/*.md` except `README.md`. Probes are whitespace-tolerant over whole file content, ⛔ never line-anchored — this prose wraps near 80 columns.

| probe | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| ASSERTION position: `ratchet\s+stays\s+at\s+zero\s+drift` | **2 files** (exactly the two above) | **0** |
| QUOTED position: same phrase inside backticks | 0 | **0** |
| QUOTED position: same phrase on a blockquote line | 0 | **0** |
| [LIT CTRL] `zod-mirror-parity` | 31 files | 32 files |
| [ABSENT CTRL] a minted token | 0 | 0 |
| corpus size | 1653 | 1654 |

⇒ the repair does **not** quote the retired rationale, so the quoted-position count is zero in both directions and the drop is real rather than relocation. The lit control moves 31 → 32 because the new entry names the ratchet.

Conclusion preserved, probed the same way: `Both halves move together` still reads **2**, and the `no KnownDrift ... entry is added` clause still reads in both bodies.

## Measurement 3 — frontmatter byte-identity, with a lit control

`check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`'s documented case 2. Frontmatter block hashed at the merge base `1cfdff814` and on this branch; the whole-file hash is the lit control and MUST differ, or the hasher is stuck.

| file | frontmatter sha256 (16) base → head | fm bytes | [LIT CTRL] whole-file sha256 (16) base → head |

| `5903-objectgantt-declared-keys.md` | `1c860f90aeaed88c` → `1c860f90aeaed88c` (identical) | 67 → 67 | `6a332ed86ba16424` → `ed004ed06cd6aca5` (differs) |
| `6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md` | `1c860f90aeaed88c` → `1c860f90aeaed88c` (identical) | 67 → 67 | `e2bc93f8cdae428a` → `5ccc57fa4986ca7d` (differs) |

Both frontmatters hash equal to each other because both declare the same two packages at the same level; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` confirms the same thing from its own side — `declared at base` equals `declares now` for both, so no declaration name is lost.
